(1) /davetiye/test-reveal-ac0fbc renders fullscreen [data-testid=invitation-reveal] with the envelope Idle scene AND a visible 'Davetiye Aç' [data-testid=reveal-open-btn] (text confirmed 'Davetiye Aç'). Clicking it starts the animation, reveals reveal-mute + reveal-skip (top-left, visible). Clicking Atla dismisses the reveal and the pink invitation body ('Test & Reveal', countdown, tören detayları, RSVP form) is shown. No JS pageerrors; only some 401s on unrelated auth-check calls (harmless). (2) RSVP: rsvp-yes/no/maybe/name/surname/count/submit all present. Filled name+surname, chose 'Emin Değilim', submitted -> success text 'Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Teşekkür ederiz!' visible. Selecting minimal + clicking preview-reveal-btn opens a fullscreen preview with a fresh invitation-reveal + Davetiye Aç button + preview-close/Tekrar Oynat; preview-close removes the reveal. (4) LCV Panosu (login expired@fotuber.com.tr on /davetiyelerim -> inv-guests-<id>): guest-manager dialog shows guest-stat-gelin '5 kişi | 0 Geliyor · 0 Gelmiyor · 0 Belki · 5 Bekliyor' and guest-stat-damat '4 kişi | 0 Geliyor · 0 Gelmiyor · 0 Belki · 4 Bekliyor' — Belki column now present per side as required. (5) 'Bekleyenlere Hatırlat' [data-testid=guest-remind-pending] and 'Bekliyor' filter [data-testid=guest-filter-pending] both visible & clickable in the filter row without JS errors. (6) Regression /hizmetler: single-line header nav (measured height 21px), all 3 CTAs cta-davetiye/cta-vesikalik-panel/cta-book-appointment + Personel Girişi render on one row.
critical_code_review_comments: InvitationReveal.jsx setTimeout duration DUR is hard-coded per style; if audio track drift changes durations later, consider driving 'finish' from the last motion transition instead of a fixed timeout.
revealSound.js runs a WebAudio graph on start — ensure AudioContext is closed in the .stop() path to free browser audio slots (currently only oscillators are stopped).
